SimplifiedChinese.format: AXDR USB/UDP 帧：ASCII 'AXDR' + uint16 小端 CAN ID + uint8 合法 CAN FD DLC + 含零填充的 Payload。MsgType = (CAN ID >> 6) & 0x1f。NORMAL(0x10)：Seq(u16),Config_ID(u8),Channel_Count(u8),float32[Count],0填充；FAST(0x18)：Seq(u16),Config_ID(u8),Sample_Count(u8),int16[Sample_Count][Channel_Count],0填充。FAST 通道数由成功 PLOT_CONFIG 回包确定，不能从 DLC 推算。
SimplifiedChinese.example: FAST 配置回包：Txn,0x04,0x01,0x00,Group=0,Config_ID,Count,uint16 Var_ID[Count]，末尾0填充。先接收成功配置回包再绘制 FAST 波形。

TraditionalChinese.format: AXDR USB/UDP：ASCII 'AXDR' + uint16 小端 CAN ID + uint8 合法 CAN FD DLC + 含零填充 Payload。NORMAL(0x10)：Seq、Config_ID、Channel_Count、float32 陣列；FAST(0x18)：Seq、Config_ID、Sample_Count、int16 採樣陣列，通道數來自成功的配置回覆，不能從 DLC 推算。
TraditionalChinese.example: FAST 的 PLOT_CONFIG 成功回覆包含 Config_ID 與 uint16 通道 ID 列表；需要先收到回覆才能解析 FAST。

English.format: AXDR USB/UDP frame: ASCII AXDR + uint16 little-endian CAN ID + uint8 legal CAN FD DLC + payload including zero padding. NORMAL(0x10): Seq(u16), Config_ID(u8), Channel_Count(u8), float32[Count], padding. FAST(0x18): Seq(u16), Config_ID(u8), Sample_Count(u8), int16[Sample_Count][Channel_Count], padding. FAST channel count comes from a successful PLOT_CONFIG RESPONSE, never from the DLC.
English.example: Successful FAST PLOT_CONFIG response contains Group=0, Config_ID, Count and uint16 Var_ID[Count] followed by DLC padding. FAST frames are decoded only after receiving their configuration.
